result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but there are a few visible issues: a typo in the search placeholder text, truncated restaurant name in the carousel, and a partially cut-off third card.

issues.description: Search placeholder text contains a typo: 'Restarants' instead of 'Restaurants'
issues.suggestion: Correct the spelling to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is visibly truncated in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, and the third card is cut off by the screen edge without any visual affordance
issues.suggestion: Ensure card widths allow full names to wrap or ellipsize gracefully, and add a partial-peek/scroll indicator so users know more content is available horizontally

issues.description: The notification bell icon overlaps the 'Deliver to' address area and its badge dot is small, making the notification indicator easy to miss
issues.suggestion: Increase badge dot size/contrast slightly and ensure clear spacing from the address text
